userDefinedCodeListEntries.entryDescription: A payment for the stay arrived after the vehicle left.
A right or payment was matched to the stay on an inexact plate match (Part 5 §5.8 rule 5).
The stay's end was set by a rule, not observed (Part 5 §5.8 rule 3).
The plate was on a plate list at the place during the stay (Part 24).
A payment covered part of the stay; set beside a status such as lateStart whose coverage began too late.
